# Wav2Lip

> > Wav2Lip is an AI-powered lip-sync tool that generates realistic talking videos by synchronizing audio with video using SyncNet technology.

The platform offers both free playground testing and subscription-based video generation services with Wav2Lip V1, supporting multiple languages and providing a credit-based system for high-resolution lip-sync processing. Users can create natural talking face animations through an intuitive dashboard interface.
